messages.subject: Using ezANOVA doesn't give the same results as STATISTICA and I cannot figure out why
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to do my first ANOVA in R using the ezANOVA() function.
My experimental design is a 2-way repeated measures design: "soa" (levels: 34, 68, 102, 200) x "congruency" (levels: 1, 2, 9). The name of my ID column is "subject". My data is in a "long" format 

head(ac.data)
  subject block trial_num soa target_identity prime_type target_type congruency
1      99     1         1 200              82          9           1          9
2      99     1         2 102              95          2           1          2
3      99     1         3  68             257          2           2          1
4      99     1         4  68              62          9           1          9

7      99     1         7  68             280          3           2          2
  prime_exposure target_exposure button_pressed   rt ac condition
1              0              36              1 1253  1     200_9
2             75              36              1 1895  1     102_2
3             75              36              2 1049  1      68_1
4              0              36              1 1732  1      68_9
5              0              36              3  765  1      34_9
7             75              36              2 1016  1      68_2

I tried using the ezANOVA() as follows:
> ezANOVA(
+     ac.data
+     , ac
+     , subject
+     , within = list("soa", "congruency")
+     , within_full = list("soa", "congruency")
+     , within_covariates = NULL
+     , between = NULL
+     , between_covariates = NULL
+     , observed = NULL
+     , diff = NULL
+     , reverse_diff = FALSE
+     , type = 2
+     , white.adjust = FALSE
+     , detailed = TRUE
+     , return_aov = TRUE
+ )


and I get this:

Warning: Converting "subject" to factor for ANOVA.
Warning: "soa" will be treated as numeric.
Warning: "congruency" will be treated as numeric.
Warning: Collapsing data to cell means first using variables supplied to "within_full", then collapsing the resulting means to means for the cells supplied to "within".
Warning: There is at least one numeric within variable, therefore aov() will be used for computation and no assumption checks will be obtained.
$ANOVA
          Effect DFn DFd       SSn       SSd        F            p p<.05       ges
1            soa   1  43 0.2049941 0.2457928 35.86252 3.799557e-07     * 0.1953237
2     congruency   1  43 0.2380994 0.4134678 24.76196 1.094497e-05     * 0.2199298
3 soa:congruency   1  43 0.1435965 0.1852552 33.33050 7.806830e-07     * 0.1453241

$aov

Call:
aov(formula = formula(aov_formula), data = data)

Grand Mean: 0.7489049

Stratum 1: subject

Terms:
                Residuals
Sum of Squares   7.023599
Deg. of Freedom        43

Residual standard error: 0.4041528

Terms:
                      soa Residuals

Deg. of Freedom         1        43

Residual standard error: 0.07560496
1 out of 2 effects not estimable
Estimated effects are balanced

Stratum 3: subject:congruency

Terms:
                congruency Residuals
Sum of Squares   0.2380994 0.4134678
Deg. of Freedom          1        43

Residual standard error: 0.09805881
1 out of 2 effects not estimable
Estimated effects are balanced

Stratum 4: subject:soa:congruency

Terms:
                soa:congruency Residuals
Sum of Squares       0.1435965 0.1852552
Deg. of Freedom              1        43

Residual standard error: 0.06563734
Estimated effects are balanced

Stratum 5: Within

Terms:
                Residuals
Sum of Squares   6.544973
Deg. of Freedom       352

Residual standard error: 0.1363586


My question is why do I get these warnings? And why do I get different F values etc in the ANOVA than what I get when I do the analysis with STATSTICA?
This is what I get when I do the analysis with STATISTICA:
Repeated Measures Analysis of Variance with Effect Sizes and Powers (results_n44) Sigma-restricted parameterization Effective hypothesis decomposition
SS Degr. of - Freedom MS F p Partial eta-squared Non-centrality Observed power (alpha=0.05)
Intercept 296.1360 1 296.1360 1812.962 0.000000 0.976831 1812.962 1.000000
Error 7.0238 43 0.1633
SOA 0.2057 3 0.0686 9.094 0.000017 0.174573 27.283 0.995498
Error 0.9724 129 0.0075

Error 2.7683 86 0.0322
SOA*CONGRUEN 0.1574 6 0.0262 3.446 0.002723 0.074191 20.675 0.942407
Error 1.9644 258 0.0076


Any help will be greatly appreciated.

Best,
Ayala
